title_zh: CaP-X:用于机器人操作编码智能体的基准测试与改进框架
one_line: Code-as-Policy gym and benchmark varying primitive abstraction, interaction and grounding; training-free CaP-Agent0 and CaP-RL, backed by closed-loop sim trials across 12 models and claimed sim2real.

held_out_env.quote: We further introduce CaP-RL, showing reinforcement learning with verifiable rewards improves success rates and transfers from sim2real with minimal gap.

code.quote: We present CaP-X, an open-access framework for systematically studying Code-as-Policy agents in robot manipulation.

title_zh: 以学生自己的风格教学:面向网页智能体的黑盒教师蒸馏
one_line: A black-box teacher finds the first error in a failed student web episode and rewrites the rest in the student's style; closed-loop gains on TimeWarp (seen/unseen versions) and live OnlineMind2Web.
one_line_zh: 黑盒教师定位学生失败轨迹的首个错误,并以学生风格重写后续步骤;在TimeWarp与真实网页上以闭环成功率验证。
